Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Brandon Ingram?

Brandon Ingram is 28 years old.

Where was Brandon Ingram born?

Brandon Ingram was born in Kinston, North Carolina.

When was Brandon Ingram born?

Brandon Ingram was born on September 2, 1997.

How tall is Brandon Ingram?

Brandon Ingram is 6-8 (203 cm) tall.

How much does Brandon Ingram weigh?

Brandon Ingram weighs 190 lbs (86 kg).

Is Brandon Ingram in the Hall of Fame?

Brandon Ingram is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Brandon Ingram drafted?

Brandon Ingram was drafted by Los Angeles Lakers, 1st round (2nd pick, 2nd overall), 2016 NBA Draft.

What position does Brandon Ingram play?

Small Forward and Power Forward.

What is Brandon Ingram's net worth?

Brandon Ingram has made at least $220,171,923 playing professional basketball.

How much does Brandon Ingram make?

Brandon Ingram made $38,095,238 in 2026.

How many rings does Brandon Ingram have?

Brandon Ingram has won 0 championships.

What is Brandon Ingram's Instagram account?

Brandon Ingram is on Instagram at 1ngram4.

What schools did Brandon Ingram attend?

Brandon Ingram attended Kinston in Kinston, North Carolina and Duke.

What are Brandon Ingram's nicknames?

Slenderman, Tiny Dog, Humble Beast, Kingram are nicknames for Brandon Ingram.
